name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-645142f35c67e8b5a5119f81666cec47ce8022ba "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once.
